title: Unnidathil Ennai Koduthen
desc: Selvam and Bhaskar, two thieves with good intentions, hide with the help of Radha who is an illegitimate child living with his father's family in the guise of a maid.

title: Anjatha Singam
desc: When a cop gets wrongly accused of murder and imprisoned for life, his son sets out to find the real culprit and clear his father's name.

title: Chinna Kannamma
desc: Aravind and Gayathri get married against their parents' wishes, and they live happily with their daughter, Saranya. However, when Gayathri dies, Aravind discovers that Saranya is not his daughter.

title: Munnariyippu
desc: Raghavan, an ex-convict, struggles with his dark history and the weight of expectations.

title: Iyer Ips
desc: A deputy commissioner strives to establish justice by any means necessary. However, trouble arises when a gangster vows to kill him.
